name: Powder Keg
text: At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a fuse counter on Powder Keg.\n{T}, Sacrifice Powder Keg: Destroy each artifact and creature with mana value equal to the number of fuse counters on Powder Keg.
rulings: [{'date': '2004-10-04', 'text': 'Only destroys artifacts and creatures with exactly the specified cost. It does not mean “less than or equal to”.'}, {'date': '2004-10-04', 'text': 'Putting on a counter is optional. If you forget, you can’t go back later even if it is something you usually do.'}]
